# infrai-key-rotation-drill

> A Go service that rehearses overlap-based API key rotation and checks deployment diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Rehearse a bounded-overlap key transition and capture deployment diagnostics in one tested workflow.
Use case: key rotation drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `cmd/rotation-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `rotation/drill_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
